newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's NLCF eyeing 300,000T Argentine corn.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's NLCF eyeing 300,000T Argentine corn.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) is considering purchasing 300,000 tonnes of Argentine corn in place of U.S. origin due to the relative price advantage of the South American crop, a senior NLCF official said on Wednesday.
He said Argentine corn was recently quoted at $109 a tonne FOB, compared with $116 a tonne FOB for U.S. corn.

NLCF has up until April to monitor prices and to decide on where it purchases the corn, because the 300,000 tonnes would be shipped between June and August, which is also the main Argentine export season, the official added.
